errors.text: The targeted property is misidentified: the hidden target concerns improving coercive field in Fe-Co-Ni-derived fcc high-entropy alloys, whereas the generated hypothesis addresses stacking-fault energy and deformation mode.
The material system is shifted from dual-phase FeCoNiTi containing fcc and C14 Laves phases to paramagnetic CoCrFeMnNi.

The generated hypothesis conflates longitudinal spin moments and magnetic entropy with orbital magnetic moments. The cited evidence does not explicitly calculate or establish an orbital-moment contribution.
It omits the central dual-phase mechanism involving fcc/C14 coexistence, antiferromagnetic coupling to Ti, spin canting, and domain-wall pinning.
It fails to reconstruct the key outcome of coercivity exceeding the approximately 100 Oe single-phase limit and reaching about 667 Oe at 400 K.
